title: How do I register for Do Not Disturb (DND) to stop promotional calls/SMS?
content:
Question: How do I register for Do Not Disturb (DND) to stop promotional calls/SMS?

Answer: Send 'START 0' via SMS to the DND short code (or use Help > DND Preferences in the app) to block all commercial communication, or 'START' followed by a category code to block specific categories only, per TRAI's DND regulations.

Topic: DND & Spam Management
